decisions.meetingReference: Quarterly Access Control & Contractor Authentication Review
decisions.decisionText: Allow engineers to use SMS 2FA fallback for production database access when hardware keys are unavailable.
decisions.rationale: Contractors reported delays receiving hardware security tokens.
decisions.conflictNotes: Security policy contradiction: Proposed decision permits SMS 2FA for production database access, directly violating the mandatory hardware FIDO2/WebAuthn requirement and SMS deprecation policy codified in #DEC-5223-1 ("Allow engineers to use SMS 2FA fallback for production database access when hardware keys are unavailable.").
decisions.conflictResolution: Reject SMS 2FA authentication fallback for production database access to maintain Zero Trust posture and ISO-27001 compliance. Hardware security keys (FIDO2/WebAuthn) remain mandatory.

decisions.meetingReference: Quarterly Access Control & Contractor Authentication Review
decisions.decisionText: Allow engineers to use SMS 2FA fallback for production database access when hardware keys are unavailable.
decisions.rationale: Remote contractors experienced shipping delays in receiving physical hardware security keys, requiring a temporary fallback method to maintain access.
decisions.conflictNotes: The newly proposed decision allows SMS 2FA fallback for production database access, which directly contradicts the historical decision that strictly requires hardware FIDO2 / WebAuthn keys and explicitly deprecates SMS 2FA to prevent phishing-resistant session hijacking vectors.
decisions.conflictResolution: Maintain the strict hardware FIDO2 / WebAuthn requirement for all production database access to comply with security standards. To address contractor shipping delays, establish an expedited courier service or provision temporary, pre-registered backup hardware keys rather than re-introducing deprecated SMS 2FA.

decisions.meetingReference: Quarterly Platform Scaling & Database Migration
decisions.decisionText: Formally commit to migrating the primary ledger to Google Cloud Spanner by December 15, 2026.
decisions.rationale: To ensure multi-region consistency and eliminate manual sharding overhead caused by legacy MySQL performance issues.

decisions.meetingReference: Quarterly Platform Scaling & Database Migration
decisions.decisionText: Restrict migration maintenance windows to Sunday 02:00-04:00 UTC to minimize client disruption.
decisions.rationale: To prevent downtime impact during peak business hours and adhere to client SLA requirements.

decisions.meetingReference: Client Success & Onboarding SLA Review
decisions.decisionText: Implement an automated PagerDuty escalation tier for critical enterprise tenants with a 15-minute acknowledgment SLA, starting Nov 15.
decisions.rationale: Addresses enterprise client requests for faster Severity-1 incident response while accommodating current engineering resource limitations.

decisions.meetingReference: Quarterly Security Task Force & Authentication Survey
decisions.decisionText: Task the security engineering team with evaluating future alternative authentication methods and gathering contractor feedback during Q1.
decisions.rationale: Necessary for next quarter planning and improving future access security.

decisions.meetingReference: API Gateway Read Optimization & Caching Sync
decisions.decisionText: Deploy a Redis cache cluster in front of the API gateway to support existing read query loads and rate limits.
decisions.rationale: Necessary to efficiently handle the 1,200 req/min rate limit and optimize read performance.

decisions.meetingReference: API Gateway Read Optimization & Caching Sync
decisions.decisionText: Configure automated email alerts when clients reach 85% of their 1,200 requests/minute limit.
decisions.rationale: Provides proactive notification before rate limits are fully exhausted.

decisions.meetingReference: Architecture & Cloud Spanner Migration Sync
decisions.decisionText: Migrate the core ledger to Google Cloud Spanner by December 15, 2026.
decisions.rationale: To resolve peak-hour write latency spikes and ensure multi-region consistency, while accounting for downtime constraints.

decisions.meetingReference: Q4 API Gateway Migration & Rate Limiting Sync
decisions.decisionText: Cap standard API clients at 1,200 requests/minute to protect core database connection pools during failovers.
decisions.rationale: Analysis of September outage showed unbounded retry storms overwhelmed PostgreSQL write replicas.
decisions.conflictNotes: Potential Conflict with Decision DEC-02 (Oct 28): Enterprise tier contracts promised burst capacity up to 3,000 req/min without throttling.
decisions.conflictResolution: Align API Platform engineering and Enterprise Client Success before adjusting client rate limits or connection pool headroom.
decisions.dependentSettingsNote: Dependent setting: 85% threshold alerts must be calibrated against approved rate caps.

decisions.meetingReference: Client Enterprise SLA & Support Tier Overhaul
decisions.decisionText: Guarantee 99.95% availability with dedicated burst headroom for Enterprise contract renewals in Q4.
decisions.rationale: Sales commitment required to secure the Horizon Capital and FinTech Global multi-year renewals.
decisions.conflictNotes: Cross-meeting conflict: API team decided a 1,200 req/min hard ceiling on Oct 30.
decisions.conflictResolution: Coordinate between Architecture and Sales Engineering to establish isolated burst capacity without compromising multi-tenant database stability.

decisions.meetingReference: Design System 2.0 Dark Mode & Accessibility Audit
decisions.decisionText: Enforce WCAG AAA 7:1 contrast ratios across all primary data tables and user notification banners.
decisions.rationale: Ensures compliance ahead of upcoming European Accessibility Act (EAA) audit.

decisions.meetingReference: Data Retention & Cold Storage Compliance Review
decisions.decisionText: Automatically transition telemetry logs to Glacier vault storage after 90 days; purge non-anonymized user logs after 365 days.
decisions.rationale: Reduces cloud infrastructure spend by 34% while satisfying ISO-27001 audit criteria.

decisions.meetingReference: Sprint 42 Retrospective & Architecture Review
decisions.decisionText: Utilize NGINX open-source sidecars for microservice ingress routing.
decisions.rationale: Replaced by Decision DEC-01 adopting Envoy v1.32 for native gRPC and circuit breaking support.

decisions.meetingReference: Security & Authentication Steering Committee
decisions.decisionText: Require hardware FIDO2 / WebAuthn keys for all production database access; deprecate SMS 2FA.
decisions.rationale: Defends against phishing-resistant session hijacking vectors identified in recent red-team exercise.
